breve: A group of foldable containers that doesn't allow more than one container to be expanded at a time.
descricao: A group of FoldableContainer-derived nodes. Only one container can be expanded at a time.

metodos.desc: Returns an Array of FoldableContainers that have this as their FoldableGroup (see 'FoldableContainer.foldable_group'). This is equivalent to ButtonGroup but for FoldableContainers.

propriedades.desc: If true, it is possible to fold all containers in this FoldableGroup.

sinais.desc: Emitted when one of the containers of the group is expanded.
